# skills.sh

> > A platform for sharing AI agent skills, Copilot extensions, and development best practices across frameworks like Next.js, Expo, Playwright, and MCP.

skills.sh hosts reusable skills for GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other AI agents, covering development tools, testing strategies, marketing workflows, and platform-specific integrations. The site aggregates community-contributed skills from organizations like Microsoft, GitHub, Vercel Labs, and individual contributors.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- copilot-skill
- best-practices
- command-line-tool
- Next.js
- Playwright
- Expo
- dependency-injection
- testing-strategies
- Power BI
- conversion-rate-optimization
- programmatic-seo
- Spring Boot
- Nuxt

## GitHub Copilot Skills

- [mcp-create-declarative-agent by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/mcp-create-declarative-agent): Create declarative agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot using MCP
- [dotnet-best-practices by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/dotnet-best-practices): .NET & C# best practices skill for Copilot with coding standards
- [kotlin-springboot by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/kotlin-springboot): Kotlin Spring Boot best practices for REST APIs & JPA entities
- [powerbi-modeling by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/powerbi-modeling): Power BI semantic modeling with DAX, star schema & RLS best practices
- [quasi-coder by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/quasi-coder): Quasi-Coder skill for natural language to code translation
- [meeting-minutes by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/meeting-minutes): Meeting minutes automation skill for GitHub Issues & Jira integration
- [dataverse-python-usecase-builder by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/dataverse-python-usecase-builder): PowerPlatform Dataverse Python SDK skill for solution architecture
- [fedora-linux-triage by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/fedora-linux-triage): Fedora Linux system triage skill using systemctl & journalctl

## Development Tools & CLI Reference

- [playwright-cli by microsoft/playwright-cli](https://skills.sh/microsoft/playwright-cli/playwright-cli): Playwright CLI command reference for browser automation & web testing
- [mcp-cli by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/mcp-cli): MCP CLI command reference for server management & tool discovery
- [gws-gmail by googleworkspace/cli](https://skills.sh/googleworkspace/cli/gws-gmail): Gmail CLI tool wrapping Gmail API v1 for email automation

## Framework Skills

- [next-upgrade by vercel-labs/next-skills](https://skills.sh/vercel-labs/next-skills/next-upgrade): Next.js upgrade automation skill with codemods & migration guides
- [nuxt by antfu/skills](https://skills.sh/antfu/skills/nuxt): Nuxt framework reference for Vue SSR & full-stack development
- [expo-dev-client by expo/skills](https://skills.sh/expo/skills/expo-dev-client): Expo dev client skill for native code testing & EAS Build deployment

## Testing & Development Practices

- [testing-strategies by supercent-io/skills-template](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/testing-strategies): Testing strategies skill covering test pyramid, Jest, & CI/CD practices
- [vibe-kanban by supercent-io/skills-template](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/vibe-kanban): AI agent Kanban board for multi-agent orchestration with MCP
